results.title: MobiDrive Cloud Storage & Sync
results.snippet:
MobiDrive is a streamlined, secure and ad-free cloud storage with handy features to backup, sync and access all your files. From its free 20GB storage available on sign in, to its rich cross-platform capabilities, MobiDrive ensures secure content transfer regardless of file format, device, platform, or location.

SECURE DRIVE WITH AMPLE STORAGE
• Want 20GB free cloud storage, zero ads and no strings attached? Just create an account, claim your free storage, and sync or backup any file.
• Need a practical video storage or photo storage but the free 20 GB aren’t enough? Upgrade your drive to up to 2TB and enjoy sufficient storage to sync and backup.

INSTANT ACCESS TO YOUR FILES
• MobiDrive’s content transfer is straightforward and fast. Secure and sync files and folders to your drive in seconds.
• Ensure your photo storage and video storage are always up-to-date with the auto backup of photos and videos to the drive.
• With MobiDrive’s seamless cross-platform capabilities you can sync your drive and create a backup on any mobile device, Windows PC or browser.

POWERFUL FILE MANAGEMENT TO KEEP YOUR DRIVE TIDY
• MobiDrive supports all major photo, video and office file formats, making it an ideal solution for photo storage, video storage, or a secure space for your work files.
• Convert files to 1200+ file formats and guarantee that your drive files are always compatible. (Premium feature)
• Organizing your drive after every backup or content transfer is a hassle. Just use the practical Collections, automatically curating your files based on their file type.
• Access previously used files quickly with the Recent Files section.

ENSURE YOUR FILES ARE ALWAYS SECURE
• Accidentally delete a file? Restore it from the Bin section, housing files you’ve deleted from your drive.
• Access previous versions of any file stored on your cloud drive and relax knowing you always have a secure backup.
• Any file you sync or backup in a content transfer to your drive is protected for 30 days, meaning that even if it was deleted or changed, you can always bring it back.

EFFORTLESS SHARING & CONTENT TRANSFER
• Need to urgently share a file but your device isn’t nearby? Just sync your drive files on any mobile device, Windows PC, or browser to make fast and secure content transfers on-the-go.
• Content transfer has never been easier, just create a download link. Share precious memories from your photo storage or video storage with friends and family in seconds.
• Enjoy dedicated ‘Shared with me’ and ‘Shared by me’ sections to keep an eye on any content transfer involving files on your drive.
• Mark a drive file as available ‘Offline’ for use without the need to sync or have internet.
• You can also share files from your drive as an attachment.

DO MORE WITH PREMIUM
Supersize your drive and unlock powerful new features for your files.
• Up to 2TB Cloud Storage - Ensure you have cloud storage for even the largest content transfer by upgrading your drive to up to 2TB.
• 180 Days of File Protection - Restore deleted files from the Bin and access version histories for an extended period of up to 180 days.
• Convert Files in 1200+ Formats - Enjoy a handy backup if a file on your drive is incompatible. Convert to all major photo, video, and office file formats.
• Premium MobiOffice Pack - Upgrade to a 2TB MobiDrive license and get a game-changer for your office files. MobiOffice shares advanced cross-platform integration with MobiDrive, allowing you to seamlessly sync and backup your office files anywhere.

results.title: pCloud: Cloud Storage
results.snippet:
pCloud is the secure place to store, preview and share files, anywhere you go. Start with up to 10 GB free storage.

You'll be able to backup photos and videos from your device, play your personal playlists, or preview work-related documents. You'll also be able to share large files with anyone and control access with password protection and expiration dates. From your vacation photos to videos and work documents, pCloud brings all your files together.

• Start with up to 10 GB free. Extend the space on your phone with up to 2 TB
• Choose where to store your files - in the United States or the European Union.
• Scan invoices, reports or receipts with an easy-to-use document scanner.
• Backup photos and videos from your phone with the option Automatic Upload.
• Access and preview files across all your devices.
• Share large files with added security (password protection, expiration date).
• Play your personal music collection with the built-in audio player.
• Get offline access to important files, when you're on the go.
• Encrypt private files with client-side encryption, using pCloud Encryption.

Use pCloud Encryption as the vault for your passwords, financial reports or other sensitive documents. The files you upload to the Crypto folder will be protected with client-side encryption. This means that they will be encrypted before they get uploaded to pCloud. With pCloud's zero-knowledge privacy policy we, as a service provider, will not know what kind of data you store in the Crypto folder.

pCloud is also available for iOS, desktop (Windows, macOS and Linux) and from my.pCloud.com.

- Drive mount / Files app integration,
- Multiple sync modes (copy, sync, move, two-way),
- Content and filename encryption,
- Photo & video backup with background mode,
- Secure sharing via encrypted link,
- Multiple accounts support,
- Manage files & directories (open, preview, download, copy, delete, rename, folder upload etc.),
- Preview different file formats (pdf, markdown, txt, audio, video),
- Background audio play-out,
- Simple text editor,
- Search within directories,
- Object Lock support,
- File versioning (delete & restore),
- Light and dark themes

Personal storage: Google Drive, Google Photos, Dropbox, Box, Microsoft OneDrive, pCloud, Proton Drive, Koofr

All backup and restore for your daily important data backup, contacts backup, SMS messages, call logs, calendar and apps. Choose local backup or cloud backup and restore it quickly with just a few clicks.

Phone problems can happen after a factory reset, when you get a new phone, or while moving your data to another device. This free phone backup and restore app lets you save your important data and restore it anytime without using a computer.

What You Can Backup and Restore
Contacts - Save your contacts and restore them anytime.
Text Messages - Backup your SMS and MMS messages, then restore them whenever you need.
Call History - Save your call history and restore it after a factory reset or when you switch to a new phone.
Calendar - Backup your calendar events and restore them later so you don't lose important dates.

Cloud Backup - Upload your backup to cloud storage to keep it safe and restore it whenever you need.

Autosync is an automatic file sync and backup tool. You choose which folder in your device should be synced with which folder in your cloud storage account, and how. Autosync will then keep files in these two folders in sync with each other, automatically and without any additional efforts from the user.

The official cloud storage apps don't have automatic sync capabilities, or only to a very limited extent. The commonly offered automatic photo upload might suffice for simple photo backup but not for keeping photos on multiple devices synchronized. If you want automatic file sync between your device and your cloud storage, you need this app.

Autosync can be configured to do automatic file sharing between your devices, to back up selected folders in your phone to your cloud storage, or to make backup copies of important document folders in your cloud storage and save them in your device for offline use. Change log
https://foldersync.io/changelog


Support
https://foldersync.io/support


FAQ
https://foldersync.io/docs/faq


Permissions

ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
Optional permission that can be granted if Foldersync should detect SSID name on Android 9 or newer.
ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
Needed to determine current network state
ACCESS_WIFI_STATE
Needed to access info about the current WiFi state (SSID etc.)
CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE/CHANGE_WIFI_STATE
These two are needed to be allowed to turn WiFi on and off
CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE
Needed to autodiscover WebDAV, SMB, FTP and SFTP servers using Bonjour/UPNP protocol
INTERNET
Needed to access the internet connection to send and retrieve files
READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
Needed to read and write files from and to SD card
RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
Needed to automatically start after reboot of device, so scheduled syncs will still run

WAKE_LOCK
Needed to keep the device running during a sync, so it doesn't enter sleep mode

results.title: Save contacts
results.snippet:
Get selected data from the phone book with just a couple of clicks! Any format is available for viewing on almost any device, be it a phone, tablet or computer. You can edit most of the formats in your favorite programs. The application will allow you to customize your folder/file settings and select the necessary data types (phones, email, and others) with the contact content preview.

The application creates files in txt format and in the Google spreadsheets, from which you can immediately download the following formats:
► Xlsx - excel format
► Ods
► Pdf
► Html(zip)
► Csv

You can view txt file it on any device. If another program cannot display the file, or there are some unreadable characters - try to change the encoding in the file settings next to the file name.

The program provides the ability to restore contacts from a txt file or a Google spreadsheet. Due to the fact that it is quite difficult to recognize the content in text files - the application can only read names, emails and phone numbers. You can write a file and load contacts from it to your phone. Use one of two formats - single-line or multi-line.

Single-line - each contact starts with a new line and there are no empty lines, there is a “:” after the name and there are “;” between the phones.

Multi-line - a first line is a contact name, contacts are separated by empty lines.

The app can restore numbers if there are no spaces or other unusual characters in them. The exception is USSD, which are recognized by the program.

The application allows you to configure each component separately:
► Contact list settings - select writing style, fields and remove duplication by merging fields. Preview allows you to see how to change the text of a single contact immediately.
► Restore settings - enable checking of existing contacts.
► File settings - enter the common name, select a folder, select encoding of the text files (UTF-8 or UTF-16), add the current date to the file name and select date format

To save contacts wait for the load from the phonebook and press the green button, which is located in the bottom corner. You will see the info window at the bottom of the screen after the creation of the file would be completed.

A system alert appears to request permission to use the phone book and memory card. Without this, the application will not be able to load contacts and save files.

Personal data is stored only on the user's device and it will not be transferred to third parties.

Autosync is an automatic file sync and backup tool. You choose which folder in your device should be synced with which folder in your cloud storage account, and how. Autosync will then keep files in these two folders in sync with each other, automatically and without any additional efforts from the user.

The official cloud storage apps don't have automatic sync capabilities, or only to a very limited extent. The commonly offered automatic photo upload might suffice for simple photo backup but not for keeping photos on multiple devices synchronized. If you want automatic file sync between your device and your cloud storage, you need this app.

Autosync can be configured to do automatic file sharing between your devices, to back up selected folders in your phone to your cloud storage, or to make backup copies of important document folders in your cloud storage and save them in your device for offline use. These are a few examples of what you can accomplish with automatic file sync.

All file transfers and communication between user devices and cloud storage servers are securely encrypted and do not go through our servers. Outsiders, including us, will not be able to decrypt and hence see or modify any file contents.

- Dropbox

- Google Drive
- HiDrive

- Kolab Now
- Koofr
- Livedrive Premium
- luckycloud
- MEGA
- MinIO
- MyDrive.ch
- NetDocuments
- OneDrive
- OneDrive for Business
- OwnCloud
- pCloud
- Proton Drive
- Storegate
- SugarSync
- WEB.DE
- Yandex Disk

- FTP
- FTPS (SSL/TLS implicit)
- FTPES (SSL/TLS explicit)
- SFTP (SSH File Transfer)
- SMB1/Samba/CIFS/Windows Share
- SMB2
- SMB3
- WebDAV (HTTPS)


Change log
https://foldersync.io/changelog


Support
https://foldersync.io/support


FAQ
https://foldersync.io/docs/faq


Permissions

ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
Optional permission that can be granted if Foldersync should detect SSID name on Android 9 or newer.
ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
Needed to determine current network state
ACCESS_WIFI_STATE
Needed to access info about the current WiFi state (SSID etc.)
CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE/CHANGE_WIFI_STATE
These two are needed to be allowed to turn WiFi on and off
CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE
Needed to autodiscover WebDAV, SMB, FTP and SFTP servers using Bonjour/UPNP protocol
INTERNET
Needed to access the internet connection to send and retrieve files
READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
Needed to read and write files from and to SD card
RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
Needed to automatically start after reboot of device, so scheduled syncs will still run

WAKE_LOCK
Needed to keep the device running during a sync, so it doesn't enter sleep mode

https://foldersync.io/changelog

FAQ

Permissions

ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
Optional permission that can be granted if Foldersync should detect SSID name on Android 9 or newer.
ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
Needed to determine current network state
ACCESS_WIFI_STATE
Needed to access info about the current WiFi state (SSID etc.)
CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE/CHANGE_WIFI_STATE
These two are needed to be allowed to turn WiFi on and off
CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE
Needed to autodiscover WebDAV, SMB, FTP and SFTP servers using Bonjour/UPNP protocol
INTERNET
Needed to access the internet connection to send and retrieve files
READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
Needed to read and write files from and to SD card
RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
Needed to automatically start after reboot of device, so scheduled syncs will still run

WAKE_LOCK
Needed to keep the device running during a sync, so it doesn't enter sleep mode

results.title: DiskDigger photo/file recovery
results.snippet:
DiskDigger can undelete and recover lost photos, images, videos, documents, or other types of non-media files from your internal memory or external memory card. Whether you accidentally deleted a photo, or even reformatted your memory card, DiskDigger's powerful data recovery features can find your lost pictures, videos, or other data, and let you restore them.

You can upload your recovered files directly to Google Drive, Dropbox, or send them via email. The app also allows you to save the files to a different local folder on your device.

Note: DiskDigger requires the "Access all files" permission on your device, to be able to search all locations on the device for lost and recoverable files. When you are asked for this permission, please enable it so that DiskDigger can search your device most effectively.

* If your device is not rooted, the app will perform a "limited" search for your lost files by performing a full search of your existing internal storage, thumbnail caches, databases, and more.

* If your device is rooted, the app will search all of your device's memory for any trace of photos, videos, and certain other types of files.

* After the scan is complete, tap the "Clean up" button to permanently delete any items that you no longer need (currently an experimental feature, available only in the Basic Scan).

* You can also use the "Wipe free space" option to erase the remaining free space on your device, so that any deleted files can no longer be recoverable.

For complete instructions, please see http://diskdigger.org/android

If you need to recover even more types of files, or for recovering the files directly over SFTP and other methods, try DiskDigger Pro!

Autosync is an automatic file sync and backup tool. You choose which folder in your device should be synced with which folder in your cloud storage account, and how. The official cloud storage apps don't have automatic sync capabilities, or only to a very limited extent. The commonly offered automatic photo upload might suffice for simple photo backup but not for keeping photos on multiple devices synchronized. If you want automatic file sync between your device and your cloud storage, you need this app.

Autosync can be configured to do automatic file sharing between your devices, to back up selected folders in your phone to your cloud storage, or to make backup copies of important document folders in your cloud storage and save them in your device for offline use. results.snippet:
This app is an automatic file sync and backup tool. It lets you automatically synchronize files and folders with Google Drive cloud storage and with your other devices. It is an ideal tool for photo sync, document and file backup, automatic file transfer, automatic file sharing between devices,...

New files in your cloud account are automatically downloaded onto your device. New files in your device are uploaded. If you delete a file on one side, it will be deleted on the other side. It works across multiple devices (your phone and your tablet). If their folders are synced with the same cloud account, they will be kept in sync with each other.

This is how Google Drive works on computers but not on Android. Two-way automatic synchronization should be an essential function of the official app. For whatever reason, it is not the case. Autosync for Google Drive is here to fill the gap.

All backup and restore for your daily important data backup, contacts backup, SMS messages, call logs, calendar and apps. Choose local backup or cloud backup and restore it quickly with just a few clicks.

Phone problems can happen after a factory reset, when you get a new phone, or while moving your data to another device. This free phone backup and restore app lets you save your important data and restore it anytime without using a computer.

What You Can Backup and Restore
Contacts - Save your contacts and restore them anytime.
Text Messages - Backup your SMS and MMS messages, then restore them whenever you need.
Call History - Save your call history and restore it after a factory reset or when you switch to a new phone.
Calendar - Backup your calendar events and restore them later so you don't lose important dates.
Apps - Save your app installation files (APK) and restore them later. You can also keep a copy of your APK files for future use.

Choose Where to Save Your Backup
Local Backup - Save your backup on your phone for quick and easy access.
Cloud Backup - Upload your backup to cloud storage to keep it safe and restore it whenever you need.
You can change where your backups are saved anytime in Settings.

Before you restore
Restore works only for backups created with this app; it can't recover previously deleted data.
This is data backup and restore, not live data transfer between phones.
Photos and videos aren't included - this tool focuses on contacts backup, SMS backup, call logs, calendar, and app backup and restore.

Secure and Private
Your data never goes to our servers. All backups stored on your device or personal Google Drive. We never collect, sell, or share your data. Complete privacy and security guaranteed.

Key Features:
SMS backup and restore
Contacts backup and restore
Call log backup and restore
Calendar backup and restore
APK and app backup and restore
Document and file backup
Google Drive cloud backup
Local storage backup
Phone clone and data transfer
One tap full phone backup
Data recovery and restore
Secure and private backup
New phone data transfer

Download Cloud Backup and Data Recovery - the best phone backup app, data transfer app, phone clone app, and data recovery app for Android. Never lose your data again!

⚠️ Disclaimer:
SMS restore requires the app to temporarily become the default SMS handler as mandated by Android OS. This role is only requested during SMS restore and not used for any other purpose. Your data is never transmitted to our servers.

Keep the parts of your Android setup that matter.

What you can back up
• Apps and APKs
• App data and selected app settings on rooted devices
• Messages and call logs
• Folders and files
• Applied wallpapers
• Saved Wi-Fi networks with Root or Shizuku on supported Android versions

Store backups your way
Save backups on internal storage, an SD card or USB drive where supported.

Connect Swift Backup to:
• Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and Box
• Mega.nz, pCloud, Filen, Yandex.Disk and Cloud Mail.Ru
• WebDAV, including Nextcloud, ownCloud and compatible NAS devices
• S3-compatible storage
• SMB, SFTP, FTP, FTPS and FTPES servers

Designed for real backup workflows
• Create device and cloud backups
• Restore individual APKs manually without root
• Use Root or Shizuku for supported batch operations

Root and Shizuku
Root is not required to back up APKs, messages, call logs, folders or wallpapers.

Backing up and restoring private app data requires root. Some protected app files and batch restore actions require Root or Shizuku, depending on your Android version. See the FAQ for exact requirements.

Premium features
• Cloud backups for apps and folders
• Scheduled backups
• Backup history, notes and protected backups
• App labels
• Custom app backup and restore configurations

Sign-in and encryption
You can use Swift Backup anonymously and offline for local backups. Google Sign-in is required for cloud backups and Premium features. Browser-based sign-in is available on devices without Google Play services.

Backups are encrypted, except APKs, expansion files and wallpapers. Backups are tied to the Swift Backup account used to create them, so use the same account when moving to another device.

results.title: Autosync for Google Drive
results.snippet:
This app is an automatic file sync and backup tool. It lets you automatically synchronize files and folders with Google Drive cloud storage and with your other devices. It is an ideal tool for photo sync, document and file backup, automatic file transfer, automatic file sharing between devices,...

New files in your cloud account are automatically downloaded onto your device. New files in your device are uploaded. If you delete a file on one side, it will be deleted on the other side. It works across multiple devices (your phone and your tablet). If their folders are synced with the same cloud account, they will be kept in sync with each other.

This is how Google Drive works on computers but not on Android. Two-way automatic synchronization should be an essential function of the official app. For whatever reason, it is not the case. Autosync for Google Drive is here to fill the gap.

All file transfers and communications between user devices and cloud storage servers are securely encrypted and do not go through our servers. No outsiders will be able to decrypt, see or modify any file contents.

Autosync can be configured to do automatic file sharing between your devices, to back up selected folders in your phone to your cloud storage, or to make backup copies of important document folders in your cloud storage and save them in your device for offline use. All file transfers and communication between user devices and cloud storage servers are securely encrypted and do not go through our servers. Outsiders, including us, will not be able to decrypt and hence see or modify any file contents.

Designed for real backup workflows
• Create device and cloud backups

Root and Shizuku
Root is not required to back up APKs, messages, call logs, folders or wallpapers.

Backing up and restoring private app data requires root. Some protected app files and batch restore actions require Root or Shizuku, depending on your Android version. See the FAQ for exact requirements.

Premium features

• Scheduled backups
• Backup history, notes and protected backups
